description: Two or more renderings, looked at together. A pure function of `payload`.
phrases: show me these two versions side by side
onion skin two versions of a figure
a contact sheet of the variants
show this at its real printed size
compare a figure under two style guides

requires.note: the view; payload in, markup out

returns: one self-contained HTML page; no server, no network, no store
notes: GENERATED from `lineart_trace.scene.inspect.gallery` by `python3 -m lineart_trace.records`. A view performs no I/O: it reads no store, calls no capability and measures nothing, so it can be rendered from a fixture and checked without the toolkit running.
